page.layout: One printed page (the right-hand page of the opening is the main page; a fragment of the facing page lies at the left edge and is not transcribed). Main text in one column; a brace diagram with boxes in the lower middle; a marginal note at the right beside the diagram ("De peccati species cap. 4."), and running head with page number at the top.

main_text.p: Calamitates circa ea quæ ad personam pertinet, sunt ea omnes, quibus omnia humanæ vitæ bona, vtpote vxor, liberi, nomen, facultates, honor, creaturæ vsus, vtilitásq; & cætera omnia obnoxia sunt. Quarum multas vide Deut.28.

Mala post vitam, sunt mala ijs hominum bonis quæ post mortem superesse possunt inflicta, vtpote nulla nominis recordatio perpetua infamia, pœna iniquitatis in posteritate.vt Psal.109. Iob.18. Mand. 2. Pro.10.7.
Misera mutatio huius vitæ est mutatio illius pro conditione multo magis misera. Heb.9.27.
Ea est mors. eius vice subita mutatio. 1.Cor.15.51. 1.Thef.4.17. ἀναλογῶς.
Mors est separatio corporis ad interitum, & animæ ad horribilem custodiam loco destinato, donec veniat plena condemnatio religandæ. Luc.6. 25. 26. 1.Pet.3.19.
Vice eius mutatio subita est mutatio humanæ vitæ ἐν ἀτόμῳ in conditionem ad pœnam æternam subeundam idoneam.
main_text.head: Hactenus de generibus peccati, eiusq; affectibus, communibus: Species sequuntur.

page.notes: Brace diagram: "Vtrumq; autem est" stands at the left of the brace; "Ioh. 8.44." and "Primarium" stand at the right; the margin note "De peccati speciebus cap.4." is at the right margin. The left edge shows the facing page, not transcribed. Some words in the diagram and the Greek are uncertain.
